items.html: And after Adam HaRishon sinned with the Tree of Knowledge, which is the world of Assiya — which he was commanded not to eat from, since he had no part in Assiya but only from Yetzira and above, as said above — and since he transgressed and ate from the Tree of Knowledge, which is Assiya, he caused a flaw in all the worlds, and all of them descended from their degree in this way: Yetzira became clothed in Assiya. Thus, the Land of Israel, which corresponded to Yetzira, receives from it only through Assiya, since Yetzira is clothed in it. And likewise Beria is clothed in Yetzira, and the Nukva of Atzilut became clothed in Beria, and ZA became clothed in his Nukva. And so likewise with all those above him — all of them descended from their degree.
